newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart CEO gets $1.5 million in salary, bonus.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart CEO gets $1.5 million in salary, bonus.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc. paid its president and chief executive, David Glass, a salary and bonus totalling almost $1.5 million for the year ended Jan. 31, the company said in a proxy statement filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Glass received a salary of $1,085,000, incentive pay of $377,580 and other compensation of $71,363. That compares with a salary of $1,035,000, no incentive payment and other compensation of $66,759 the year earlier.

In addition, the nation's top retailer awarded Glass 135,625 options to purchase common shares at an exercise price of $24, currently worth $1,066,013. The options expire on Jan. 9, 2007. The previous year, he was awarded 66,064 options to purchase shares in the Bentonville, Ark-based retailing giant.
Wal-Mart's stock rose 25 cents to $28.125 on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was among the most active issues at midday.
